heading: Customer testimonials
subheading: India Escapes uses Feefo, the global feedback engine, to gather genuine and independently verified reviews.

reviews.title: Best trusted north india operator
reviews.author: Dream63176979047
reviews.text: Booked Himachal trip with trusted vendor for Himachal. Great experience and reliable service.

reviews.title: Good experience
reviews.author: Journey827984
reviews.text: Toy train ride Shimla to Tara Devi. Advertised as a 4-hour guided tour but the guide was present only briefly before the train journey. The train ride lasted around 45 minutes and seating arrangements were disappointing. We enjoyed the train ride and visit to Tara Devi Temple, but the experience did not match the advertised description.

reviews.title: Wonderful North India tour with India Escapes

reviews.text: Fantastic North India tour with well-planned hotels, transportation, sightseeing, and support. Special thanks to Mr. Sahil Shyam for arranging the package according to our needs. Highly recommended for anyone planning a holiday in India.

reviews.title: Amazing trip

reviews.text: We booked our Spiti Valley tour with India Escapes and had an amazing experience. Excellent coordination by Bhawna Thakur and the entire team. Highly recommended for future trips.
